items.text: Execute mobile application App information security testing (MAS certification and OWASP MSTG)
Perform smartphone built-in software information security testing (ESS certification)
Automated App Detection Tool Module Development
App and Smartphone Information Security Technology Research
TOEIC score 350 or equivalent English level
Basic Linux command operation, basic TCP/IP operation. Familiar with App information security detection-related tools (BurpSuite, ADB, shell script, MobSF, Acunetix)
Those with information security certification (CEH) are preferred
This role requires initial training at the Xindian office. Once you are familiar with the responsibilities and able to work independently, you may request to transition to the Linkou office.

description.text:
【工作內容】
執行行動應用App資安檢測(MAS認證與OWASP MSTG)
執行智慧型手機內建軟體資安檢測(ESS認證)
自動化App檢測工具模組開發
參與ISO 17025實驗室運作
App與智慧型手機資安技術研究
【必要資格】
TOEIC成績350或同等英文程度
基礎Linux指令操作,基礎TCP/IP運作.孰悉App資安檢測相關工具(BurpSuite, ADB, shell script, MobSF, Acunetix)
具資安認證(CEH)者佳
接受身心障礙求職者應徵
【上班地點】
此職務前期須先進新店辦公室進行培訓，熟悉業務並判斷可獨立作業後，方可與主管申請至林口辦公
Job Responsibility-
-Execute mobile application App information security testing (MAS certification and OWASP MSTG)
-Perform smartphone built-in software information security testing (ESS certification)
-Automated App Detection Tool Module Development
-Participate in ISO 17025 laboratory operation
-App and Smartphone Information Security Technology Research
Qualifications-
-TOEIC score 350 or equivalent English level
-Basic Linux command operation, basic TCP/IP operation. Familiar with App information security detection-related tools (BurpSuite, ADB, shell script, MobSF, Acunetix)
-Those with information security certification (CEH) are preferred
-Accepting job applicants with disabilities
Work Location-
-This role requires initial training at the Xindian office. Once you are familiar with the responsibilities and able to work independently, you may request to transition to the Linkou office.
